name: How should I prepare my home before a baseboard installation team arrives?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before a baseboard installation team arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners should clear furniture, cords, and personal items at least three to four feet away from walls so carpenters have room to measure, cut, and swing pneumatic tools. Before the crew arrives, decide whether you want the baseboards painted before installation or finished on the wall, and confirm if baseboards need to match existing door trim thickness. If you have pets, make arrangements to keep them secured away from open work zones and cutting stations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture at least three feet from the walls, secure pets, and verify that the baseboard profile and thickness align with your existing door casings.
